# Contributing

For setup, tests, design boundaries and pull requests, read the
[contributing guide](../docs/how-to/development/contribute.md).

Platform changes belong in this repository. Registry changes belong in
[comeni-registry](https://github.com/comeni-project/comeni-registry):

- [Write a tool contract](../docs/how-to/registry/add-tool.md).
- [Make a choice depend on data](../docs/how-to/registry/write-rule.md).

A change spanning both repositories needs separate pull requests, with the registry
change first. Code is Apache-2.0; registry data is CC-BY-4.0; vendored modules retain
their own licences.

Report vulnerabilities privately using [the security policy](SECURITY.md).
